info.title: Kifiya Banking API Developer Challenge
info.description:
Reference banking API used by the Kifiya **Mobile** and **Web** developer challenges.

### Authentication flow
1. `POST /api/auth/register` (creates the user and an initial **CHECKING** account) or use a demo user below.
2. `POST /api/auth/login` returns `accessToken` (valid 10 minutes) and `refreshToken` (valid 24 hours).
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every other endpoint.
4. On **401** call `POST /api/auth/refresh-token`; both tokens are rotated. If that also fails, log in again.

### Demo users (available on the hosted API)
| username | password | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `demo.jane` | `Password123!` | CHECKING + SAVINGS accounts with sample history |
| `demo.john` | `Password123!` | use one of his account numbers as a transfer recipient |

Fetch `GET /api/accounts` while logged in as one demo user to discover account numbers.

### Conventions
* Paged responses have the shape `{ content: [], totalElements, totalPages, size, number, first, last }`; `page` is 0-based, `size` defaults to 10, `sort=field,asc|desc`.
* Timestamps are ISO-8601 local date-times **in UTC without an offset**, e.g. `2025-06-01T10:30:00.123`.
* Amounts are decimal numbers with 2 fraction digits.
* Every error has the shape of `ErrorResponse` with an application `code`:

| code | meaning | HTTP |
|---|---|---|
| AUTH_001 | invalid credentials / not authenticated | 401 |
| AUTH_002 | user not found | 404 |
| AUTH_003 | username already exists | 400 |
| AUTH_004 | email already exists | 400 |
| AUTH_005 | invalid or expired token | 401 |
| ACC_001 | account not found | 404 |
| ACC_002 | insufficient funds | 400 |
| ACC_003 | transfer to the same account | 400 |
| ACC_004 | account does not belong to the user | 403 |
| TXN_001 | invalid amount | 400 |
| TXN_003 | wrong transaction type for this endpoint | 400 |
| TXN_004 | transaction not found | 404 |
| VAL_001 | request validation failed | 400 |
| GEN_001 | unexpected server error | 500 |

Browser clients are allowed via CORS from the configured origins (`CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`).

post.description: Creates the user and automatically opens an initial CHECKING account with a zero balance. The `passwordHash` field carries the plain password; it is hashed server-side.

400.description: Validation failed (VAL_001), username taken (AUTH_003) or email taken (AUTH_004)

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token AND a new refresh token (rotation). Clients must replace both stored tokens. Call this when a protected request returns 401.

401.description: Refresh token invalid or expired (AUTH_005): the user must log in again

400.description: Validation failed (VAL_001) or a business rule was violated (see `code`)

post.description: Authenticates with username and password (sent in the `passwordHash` field) and returns a short-lived access token plus a refresh token.

get.summary: List my accounts, or fetch one by account number
get.description: Without `accountNumber`: a page of the authenticated user's accounts (`page`, `size`, `sort`, e.g. `sort=balance,desc`). With `accountNumber`: the single matching account, which must belong to the user.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: Optional: return only the account with this number.

403.description: The account or transaction does not belong to the authenticated user (ACC_004)

404.description: Resource not found (AUTH_002 user, ACC_001 account, TXN_004 transaction)

200.description: Page of accounts, or a single account when `accountNumber` is given

404.description: Resource not found (AUTH_002 user, ACC_001 account, TXN_004 transaction)

post.description: Deducts `amount` from `accountNumber` (must be owned by the caller) and records a BILL_PAYMENT transaction.
